channel.title: Openai.com/Blog on .NET Ramblings
channel.description: Recent content in Openai.com/Blog on .NET Ramblings

item.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
item.description: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/model-misalignment-reporting-framework

item.title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/helping-older-adults-use-ai-in-everyday-life

item.title: Reimagining advertising with AI
item.description: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/reimagining-advertising-with-ai

item.title: How to connect AI usage to business value
item.description: Learn how ChatGPT Work and Codex analytics help teams understand AI usage and spend, identify training needs, and connect adoption to business outcomes. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/how-to-connect-ai-usage-to-business-value

item.title: How workers are unlocking new ways of working
item.description: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/unlocking-new-ways-of-working

item.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
item.description: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/fyxer

item.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
item.description: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/perplexity-improving-accuracy-with-astra

item.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
item.description: Learn how OpenAI evolved Habitat from a Python library into a globally distributed storage platform serving 1 billion ChatGPT users and 22M requests per second. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/scaling-storage-one-billion-users-part-one

item.title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
item.description: César de la Fuente’s lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/using-codex-chatgpt-to-search-for-new-antimicrobials

item.title: Now everyone can put data to work
item.description: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/put-data-to-work

item.title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
item.description: OpenAI and GSA will offer eligible federal, state, local, and tribal governments $0 license fees, 50% off usage, and expanded cyber defense support. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/expanding-ai-access-us-government

item.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
item.description: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services, combining built-in financial data and GPT-6 Astra for research, modeling, and client-ready materials. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-financial-services

item.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
item.description: GPT‑Live‑1 brings natural, full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and telephony support. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-live-1-in-the-api

item.title: Introducing the Agents API
item.description: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-agents-api
